name: Myo-inositol

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A cyclic sugar alcohol serving as a precursor to inositol phosphate second messengers in the insulin signalling pathway. Studied principally in polycystic ovary syndrome for insulin sensitivity.

systems.note: Taken for insulin sensitivity via inositol phosphoglycan second messengers; the intended effect.

monitors.why: The insulin-sensitivity endpoint it is taken for.
